summary: PolyPid Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its completion of a New Drug Application (NDA) submission to the FDA for D-PLEX 100, a product candidate to prevent surgical site infections. The filing includes a press release summarizing the submission and regulatory designations. No deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is involved; this is a routine regulatory milestone update for a biopharmaceutical company.
